english: At the end of the sewer-path, you encounter a stove.
Around it sits some crates, and what looks like a ragged bedroll.
We got ourselves a big sewer rat here.
Big enough to camp and cook.
The goblin looks around the dark, damp tunnel.
I don't like this one bit.
No sane person would rest here. Or survive.
Some rats scurrying around in the corners. Nothing else.
Some rats scurrying- and some movement in the water.
Leaning in, you see symbols hatched into the corners of the wood.
The goblin inspects them as well.
We've had shipments going missing on Waterlane, in periods.
Now I know where they end up. He taps the crate. "Spices."
Just food. Over time it's been a lot.
A glance reveals most are empty. Whoever is down here is clearly siphoning off resources from the Halfway Bridge Tribe.
Where would they get these crates from?
Obviously, the rats are eating it.
Due to the esoteric nature of the City Below, this sewer lane must have transformed them into ruthlessly intelligent criminals.
Criminals hell-bent on taking over this crumbling city of yours.
Obviously, this is a hideout of some kind.
These poor people. They must be starving to need this much sustenance.
It must be because of your deep, unending hunger.
Several of the crates are marked as 'HWBT'.
Someone lives down in the sewers? ...Here?
Seeing all this food is making me hungry.
Hm. What should I do about this?
Yes. That is when a man seeks himself alone, instead of together with other lesser beings.
You know what. Sure. Why not.
Must be feeding a lot of people.
Considering the last time you had a decent meal, was...
It was over a week ago at this point.
Surprisingly you're able to stand. It's honestly impressive.
A feat showcasing the indomitable spirit of man.
You are, as they say, running on fumes.
Who knows? It's the Halfways' business.
You should report the loss of these crates, for sure.
I've been trying to nail this thief for a while. Figured it was some organized thing.
And considering the size of this haul... it's got to be.
And you never thought to check the sewers?
So what do you propose? Should we keep guard and see if they come back?
Honestly? This whole thing is just creeping me out.
It's not even connected to Waterlane. Except for the water-flow, and that's-
He stops and squints at the water.
I have a feeling you're going to tell me.
They've been dumping crates into the water flow! Then catching them down here.
Probably with a net or something.
The goblin glances around the tunnel.
Diabolical. I'd be impressed if it wasn't my job to keep track of this shit.
You know, I've been asking myself that very question.
And I could never quite figure it out. But look...
The goblin shoves the loose lid of a crate, revealing an empty inside.
Hm. Maybe there's a colony of sewer-folk eating that stuff.
Oh gods. They've got a mega-monster down here!
Could they be shipping it to someplace else?
It is a lot of calories.
We've lost maybe one or two of these crates, every other month.
Not enough for a dozen people. But a handful? Sure.
I don't think you have that authority.
Of course I do. I'm The Cleric.
Whatever they're doing, it's being eaten here.
Off the top of your head, you calculate that three full grown adult human men could live on this amount without problem.
Or... one very large creature. Like a Loxorii, or Minotaur.
Is it weird to eat food?
Is he questioning your need for calories? What's going on here?
He's calling you spindly and weak. Or something.
Why do you act surprised? I am a human who eats food. That's normal.
I haven't seen you eat anything but apples. I think.
I think I ate some mushrooms off the walls too.
Adjacent to garbage is still garbage.
But look, I just assumed you weren't the type to get hungry.
Of course I do. I'm normal.
I guess I'm not exactly a foodie.
No, you're right. Food ain't my style.
That does explain it. A bit.
Possibly. We could also go get backup.
I know we're on the 'tea shop mission', but-
This is kind of a big deal for the Halfways. Lady Sageleaf will be happy to finally get this thorn cut down.
We don't have time for that, Snell.
I somehow have the feeling that whatever is eating all of this won't be too happy about us finding the 'stash'.
You do random shit all the time!
Oh yeah. I do, don't I?
He sure did. What a power move.
He gives you a frustrated look.
Why don't we call this a quest too, eh?
Oh. What's the name of the quest?
That's an awful name for a quest.
We can call it, The Food Quest.
Yeah? What would you call it then, smart-ass?
I don't think the potatoes need such a main focus, really.
Eh. I mean, sure. Why not?
A bit generic, but yeah, sure. Let's go with that.
So maybe we can take some time to deal with this.
You've heard this phrase before. Don't comment on it.
I am, Snell. I... I just did.
(Look at the goblin like a newborn bird in the nest looks at its mama.)
Saying or telling - you're still just narrating. It's quite strange.
I don't get you and your strange ways, Snell. I must simply be far too human.
Oh. I get it. (Don't get it.)
I'm not going to stop you. Who likes being in the sewers?
Yeah. Lots of potential for dungeoneering.
Agree to agree- disagree. Agree to disagree.
Sorry. The sewer fumes must be getting to me.
The worst kind of dungeoneering, maybe. The slimy kind.
The goblin does not see it. Due to the thing on your head.
Your companion gasps for air, as he glances back.
You watch as his entire being suddenly leaves his corporeal body.
For an instant, he is not a goblin. He is a ghost.
What's wrong, Snell? You look pale.
The goblin is already on the move. His sling - loaded - spinning - aiming.
To see hunt come to Kraaid? How good...
You watch the hulking mass of flesh and wet scales rising from the shadows of the sewer.
It towers over you. Its gaping maw widened into what could be construed as a mocking smirk.
Bow down. Before it is too late.
You must stand tall as it consumes you.
But if there's any chance to de-escalate - do it NOW!
(Bow your head.) "My life is yours, Beast."
Raise your fists, and throw a punch.
Oh SURE, I'll get RIGHT ON IT!
The goblin is angry because you are both about to die.
With determination and resolve, you take a decisive step forth.
And you throw a punch at the beast.
You hit him in the snout.
Yet all it seems to do is cause the grin upon its maw to widen.
However, you're only able to strike at the thick hide. It absorbs the punch like nothing else.
The grin upon its maw widens even further.
You say the words and gather a necrotic force in your palm.
A strain is put on your muscles.
The initial blast makes contact, shooting black veins across the beast.
It lets out a horrible growl and is pushed back.
Yet the rest of dark energy simply fades upon the crocodile's thick hide.
It is surging with necrotic power.
You say the words and gather the necrotic force.
Yet when your fist goes forth, and you make contact...
The dark energy simply fades upon the crocodile's thick hide.
As you whisper the words and snap your fingers before the beast, you see the glittering effect of the charm take hold...
Snell's sling creates an incredible sound, echoing down the tunnel. He lets his stone fly in a powerful blast.
The projectile hits the monster right on the neck, causing him to let out an angry growl.
As if all the playful toying with his food is suddenly over...
Silent and focused, it reaches your face, and entire body, enveloping you with its maw.
You manage to squirm out of its grip before it rips your being into shreds.
You can't let that happen again. Shit, shit, shit!
The croc brings forth a jagged meat cleaver.
A horrific weapon to behold, if wielded by a man.
Held by this beast, it is DOOM.
This psychopathic monster just loves the thrill of the hunt over everything else.
Take that from him, and you take away the fun.
It swings the hatchet, missing your stomach by an inch.
Hunt? No, STOP! I GIVE IN! (Bow your head.)
The second strike also goes right past your flesh.
The second strike however goes just where the beast wants it.
A frustrated shriek? No. One of pleasure.
Your companion takes a step back, while keeping a wary eye on the beast.
He's unsure if he should strike again, or see if there's some strange peace to be found here.
It stares at you with cold, blank eyes.
A beast who developed consciousness, but lives without care for others.
Inches away, the croc-creature makes a deep growling sound.
He gives you a shove with his claws.
The goblin sends a quick glance between the two of you.
I don't think those two are exclusionary.
Well, I don't want to be hunted, so... stop.
You whisper the words in a rushed tone, and snap your fingers.
Immediately you see within the smirking beast's eyes - that twinkle.
A creepy croaking noise comes out of its maw.
The goblin takes a deep breath, leaning on his knees.
What does he mean by that?
That does not mean anything. The goblin is delirious from adrenaline.
You assume he means that he's all 'snacked out'.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> offers guidance to friend. How goes the hunt?
The beast has a different tone with you now.
As if his bloodlust was instantly sated.
Did you steal from the Halfway Bridge Tribe?
Can you promise not to kill us?
That's not what I asked. Whom do you serve down here?
The crocodile stops and thinks for a moment.
That's like one of those fairytale titans, I think. Creepy.
He looks you up and down. "<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> does not kill..."
Why do I have a hard time believing you?
Why does it feel like the fight's not over yet?
Hope you know what you're doing, Cleric.
As the charm fades from the beast's dead eyes, it lets out a rumbling noise.
The goblin takes a deep breath. Then he hisses at you under his breath.
I am The Cleric, yes. Get it right.
The croco-beast's tail whips around, sending dust up into your face.
The croco-beast rushes forward and grabs you by the neck.
No! I am! I'm Cleric! That's me!
He tightens the grip as you mutter out a faint response.
...no, no okay, I'm a cleric. I'm The Cleric, even.
...I'm Agrarian...! No wait, shit. That's politics. I mean, uh...
...I'm whatever you want me to be. Please don't kill me.
Cleric. Yes, you are the one.
The beast lumbers over to the encampment. You look on, taking heavy breaths.
Snell leans on his knees. He appears to be shaking.
Kraaid sits down on a crate, in front of the little stovetop.
Hunt is done for daytime. Now is rest. And cooking!
What in the world have you stumbled onto here?
You have an urge to fight this thing to the death.
Yet you know, you are no match for it. Not now.
The hulking beast looks at you with a deep hunger.
What do you hunt down here?
Those rats really seem to like you.
I have captured all the rats, Kraaid. (Hand them to the monster, one by one.)
I found this rat. (Show him the white rat.)
Is it okay if I have a chat with your rats?
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> saw human in yellow go past.
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> meant to eat such fancy human. But this human was fast... and turned invisible before <wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> could approach...
<wiggle>Kraaid</wiggle> did hear fancy yellow human speak to self while walking past. Humans said: <wiggle>where is this damn secret passage, again</wiggle>.
So he went... into the dungeon?
Fancy human came from southern caves - going into dungeon. Yes...
The monster smirks. Or it makes no expression at all, because it always smirks.
The monster stares at you, as you hold up the white rat in an uncomfortable grip.
There are five of them. They make a lot of noise when they come around.
(Put the rat back in your pouch.) I guess I'll have to find all five rats then.
Then you should probably reconsider before you head out on a rat-hunting mission.
Since nobody has promised you any pay for it.
Kraaid has no problem with intra-species fraternization...
Kraaid does not focus on you, nor the rats around him.
Kraaid just keeps on grilling. He just won't stop.
You cast the spell, and suddenly the squeaking becomes clear.
...and if we break those chains, the workers' paradise will be right AROUND THE CORNER!
You FOOL! Giving in to foreign ideology will destroy everything we have built!
Can't we all just be friends?
If you'd just let the market decide, we wouldn't need any of this!
They're imitating. Mock play turned inanely real.
Five tiny heads snap toward you.
Oh. The human, the RED RAT says flatly.
Hello! squeaks the WHITE RAT cheerfully.
Wonderful. Is it time to be transported to another part of the world again? mutters the YELLOW RAT.
Iron human. Sympathizer of steel, observes the GREEN RAT with disdain. "At least you put us with an ally."
Death comes for us all eventually... whispers the BLACK RAT.
What are you all doing here?
What do you think of Kraaid?
I don't think you guys can vote in the election, right?
You're very politically engaged for... rats.
Was it okay that I brought you all together?
Great. Thanks for the enlightening talk. (Break the spell.)
We live here now! the WHITE RAT says brightly.
Crocodile is a good teacher, the RED RAT adds.
The big guy doesn't eat us, which is... pragmatic. The YELLOW RAT seems pleased.
A temporary alliance of convenience, the GREEN RAT sniffs. "Until the revolution."
